data: Does the orange dashed line represent the average F1 of rare words appearing <=1 time?

The orange dashed line represents the average F1 score for rare words appearing 1 time. The caption explicitly states this, and the figure shows multiple lines representing different categories of rare words. The orange dashed line is labeled as '≤1 Avg', which indicates it represents the average F1 score for rare words appearing 1 time or less. Therefore, the orange dashed line does not represent the average F1 of rare words appearing <=1 time.
